motivation: A 25km camera-study center-to-island-centroid cut excluded sites on large islands. v1.248 geography supports 78 camera study IDs on four area-matched physical island candidate entities, over three original heldout spatial blocks. Verify real photography observations without treating non-detections as absences.

precommitted_field_panel.excluded_geography: Borneo/Kalimantan original island 80946 is geographically confounded with Indonesia admin0 country-fragment; 1 source survey held separately, no camera outcomes for that survey are decoded.
precommitted_field_panel.taxon_filter: Only original exact 38 taxon names, using preexisting v1.188 dot/underscore punctuation canonicalization, class Mammalia, verified 2-part binomial.
precommitted_field_panel.records_definition: Positive independent photo-record support when records is a finite nonnegative integer greater than 0. Sum positive counts per study×taxon, do not interpret as unique individuals or census abundance.

domestic_encoding_conservative.unknown_domestic: Exclude from confidently non-domestic summary; report separately. Do not retroactively declare unknown values wild.

outputs: Per-island matched original ID, frozen source study ID count and sum surveyed effort
count of distinct originally overlapping 38 taxa with >0 positive capture records
count of survey IDs with >0 positive overlap; number of taxa recorded in >1 survey ID
sum of source independent photo records as a descriptive detection intensity, not individual abundance
domestic status categories and separately conservative non-domestic-positive taxa
list of 38-overlap taxa with repeated independent-study positive recordings, if any
interpretation: Independent field photo detections are a potentially useful positive-only ecological transport check. They DO NOT independently confirm original 529-species GEB graph skill, because original predictions are unopened, non-detection is not absence, island-ID mapping is a geometry candidate and only four islands/three blocks are supported.
